questions.q_en: Two trains are running on parallel tracks, in the same direction at the speed of 80 km/h and 90 km/h, respectively. The trains crossed each other in 3 minutes. If the length of one train is 230 m, then what is the length (in m) of the other train?
questions.solution_en:
Since trains are running in same direction. So, relative speed = 90 - 80 = 10 km/h = 10 * 5/18 m/s = 25/9 m/s

Time taken by trains to cross each other = (sum of length of both the trains)/(relative speed)

3 * 60 = (230 + length of other train)/(25/9)

230 + length of other train = 500

Length of other train = 270 meters

questions.q_en: In a playground, every two children play chess between them, every four children play carrom among them, and every five children play basketball among them. If the total number of chess boards, carrom boards, and basketballs together is 114 and all children play each game, then find the total number of children.
questions.solution_en:
Let the total number of children be 'X'.

Therefore,

The total number of children who play chess = X/2

The total number of children who play carrom = X/4

The total number of children who play basketball = X/5

A/Q

X/2 + X/4 + X/5 = 114

(10X + 5X + 4X)/20 = 114

19X/20 = 114

X = 114 * 20/19

X = 120

Hence, the total number of children is 120.

questions.q_en: A circle of centre O circumscribed a triangle PQR and a tangent MQ is drawn at point Q. It is also given that- ∠PRQ = 70°, ∠PQM = x° and ∠OPQ = y°, then what is the value of (x - y)?
questions.solution_en:
∠PRQ = 70°, ∠PQM = x° and ∠OPQ = y°

∠OQP = ∠OPQ [OP = OQ = Radius]

∠POQ = 2 * ∠PRQ [Angle which is subtended by an arc at the centre of a circle is double the size of the angle subtended at any point on the circumference]

∠POQ = 2 * 70° = 140°

In △POQ-

∠POQ + ∠OQP + ∠OPQ = 180°

140° + ∠OPQ + ∠OPQ = 180°

∠OPQ = y° = 20°

y = 20

∠OQM = 90° [Angle between radius and tangent.]

∠OQP + ∠PQM = 90°

x° = 90° - 20°

x = 70

(x - y) = 70 - 20 = 50°
questions.solution_hi:
∠PRQ = 70°, ∠PQM = x° and ∠OPQ = y°

∠OQP = ∠OPQ [OP = OQ = Radius]

∠POQ = 2 * ∠PRQ [Angle which is subtended by an arc at the centre of a circle is double the size of the angle subtended at any point on the circumference]

∠POQ = 2 * 70° = 140°

∠OQP + ∠PQM = 90°

x° = 90° - 20°

questions.q_en: Perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 36 cm and perimeter of circle is 220 cm. Find the difference between side of triangle and radius of circle. (use π = 22/7)
questions.solution_en:
Perimeter of equilateral triangle

Side of triangle = 36/3 = 12 cm

Perimeter of circle = 2 πr

According to question,

2 πr = 220

2 * 22/7 * r = 220

r = 220 * 7/(22 * 2)

r = 35 cm

Required difference = 35 - 12 = 23 cm

questions.q_en: Volume of a spherical ball is 4.5π m3. Calculate its surface area.
questions.solution_en:
Let the radius of spherical ball is 'r' m.

Volume of spherical ball = 4/3 * π * r3

4.5π = 4/3 * π * r3

3.375 = r3

Radius of spherical ball = 1.5 m

Therefore, surface area of spherical ball = 4 * π * r2

= 4 * π * 1.5 * 1.5

= 9π m2

questions.q_en: Total surface area of the cylinder is 1364 cm2 and the height of the cylinder is 24 cm. If the radius of the cylinder is equal to the radius of a sphere, then find the curved surface area of the sphere.
questions.solution_en:
Total surface area of the cylinder = 2πr (r + h)

1364 = 2 * 22/7 * r (r + 24)

=> 217 = r2 + 24r

=> r2 + 24r - 217 = 0

=> r2 + 31r - 7r - 217 = 0

=> r*(r + 31) - 7*(r + 31) = 0

=> (r - 7)*(r + 31) = 0

=> r = 7 [Neglect negative value]

Hence, the curved surface area of the sphere = 4πr2

= 4 * 22/7 * 7 * 7

= 616 cm2
